name: thz-lang-workspace
description: Orquestrador do ecossistema THZ-LANG: motor TypeScript (referência/tooling) e motor JVM (thz-core, thz-cli, thz-gui — repos independentes consumidos via composite build).

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix thz-lang-engine && npm run build:jvm
scripts.build:jvm: npm run core:publish && npm run cli:jar
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:core && npm run test:gui
